thread:
Hana: quick PR check for Security docs. Legal flagged 'we are SOC2 compliant'. Proposing: 'Redwood maintains controls aligned with SOC 2 criteria and undergoes independent third-party assessment.' Also adding a tiny audit-log example (before/after) and a curl + python snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2501

Elliot: good call. keep examples short and labeled (json/bash/python) so the linter likes them. engineers asked for a note about default retention (hosted: 90d) and that Dedicated/Private are configurable.

Hana: pasted examples below. BEFORE (raw event):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_2028_0001",
  "user": { "id": "user_12", "email": "kelly@corp.com" },
  "action": "api.key.create",
  "timestamp": "2028-04-01T08:00:00Z"
}
```
AFTER (pseudonymized for export):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_2028_0001",
  "user": { "id": "anon_9f1b", "email": "REDACTED" },
  "action": "api.key.create",
  "timestamp": "2028-04-01T08:00:00Z",
  "pseudonymized": true
}
```
CURL ingest example with retention header:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Audit-Retention: 90d" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"api.key.create","details":"..."}'
```
Python SDK example (pseudo):
```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
client.log_event({"event_type":"api.key.create"}, retention_ttl="90d", pseudonymize_fields=["user.email"])
```

Sara: Legal ACK on the SOC 2 wording. small edit: prefer 'SOC 2' (with a space) in the final doc and add this customer action line: 'For attestation copies or export procedures, contact compliance@redwood.com.'

Hana: added the compliance contact and the default retention note. docs-ci-bot, will merge once lint + CI pass. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
